overall_summary: Sample size is small (10 videos). Early signal shows strong viewer retention on intimate relationship dynamics (husband-wife/relationship conflicts) over generic motivation or sibling topics.

winning_patterns.evidence: or5gtaBpRVY (Wife Emotional Video) scored 1,655 views (4.7x baseline average) and NO5fdHLxFL4 scored 350 views.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on subtle, unspoken relationship truths and partner emotional dynamics.

winning_patterns.pattern: Mid-Morning UTC Upload Timing (07:00-08:30 AM UTC)
winning_patterns.evidence: Top 3 performing videos (1655, 350, 288 views) were all published between 07:28 and 08:02 UTC.
winning_patterns.action: Schedule high-priority emotional relationship content between 07:00 AM and 08:30 AM UTC (12:30 PM - 2:00 PM IST).

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister videos (jfmMztnam_A, fAAoIQCRMXU) and Brother video (m4cgM90y9JU) underperformed at 18, 130, and 109 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid surface-level family quotes without a high-stakes emotional twist or concrete conflict.
